g.title: HR_APPRAISALREVIEWMATRIX_VIEW
g.text: Scores Matrix - With this entity, you can access all individual performance scores between two dates for a Person, across two set of columns representing X Score and Y Score. This entity is suitable to be used in a Matrix Wizard to create, for example, 9 box analytics.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
The Identifier of the Person record.
The Identifier of the Company Relationship record.
Reference to the Appraisal Cycle where the X Score was collected.
Reference to the Appraisal Type where the X Score was collected.
Identifier of the Appraisal Review where the X Score was collected.
States if the Review where the score X comes from is the Primary/Main review.
States if the review where the score X comes from is the Summary review.
Reference to the Appraisal Role who gave the X Score.
The state of the review where the X Score comes from. Can be Submitted or Draft.
Reference to the X component score in the individual appraisal.
Reference to the X Score library component.
X discrete score rating adjusted and normalised.
X Score expressed as a percentage.
X Score adjusted as a percentage.
X Normalized Calibrated score scale value
Reference to the Appraisal Cycle where the Y Score was collected.
Reference to the Appraisal Type of the Y Score was collected.
Identifier of the Appraisal Review where the Y Score was collected.
States if the Review where the score Y comes from is the primary/main review.
States if the Review where the score Y comes from is the Summary review.
Reference to the Appraisal Role who gave the Y Score.
The state of the Review where the Y Score comes from. Can be Submitted or Draft.
Reference to the Y component score in the individual appraisal.
Reference to the Y Score library component.
Y discrete score adjusted rating and normalised.
Y Score expressed as a percentage.
Y Score adjusted as a percentage.
